bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to transportation; making certain technical and clarifying changes related to county state-aid highway fund apportionment; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, sections 162.07, subdivision 6; 162.08, subdivision 1.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 162.07, subdivision 6, is amended to read:

Subd. 6.
Estimates to be made if information not provided.
In the event that any county fails to submit the information required under this section, the commissioner must estimate the lane-mileage and the money needs of the county. The commissioner must use the estimate in determining the apportionment formula. The commissioner may withhold payment of the amount apportioned to the county until the information is submitted.

Sec. 2.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 162.08, subdivision 1, is amended to read:

Subdivision 1.
Allocation for cities having less than 5,000 population.
(a) Upon determining the sum of money to be apportioned to each county as provided under section 162.07, the commissioner must allocate a percentage of the sum for expenditure solely on those portions of each county's county state-aid highways located within cities having a population of less than 5,000, according to the last federal decennial census, or, if incorporated during the ten-year period between federal decennial censuses, according to their incorporation census.
(b) The percentage allocated under paragraph (a) for each county equals the percentage that the total needs of the county state-aid highway system in the applicable cities bears to the total county state-aid highway needs in that county. Money allocated under paragraph (a) must be set apart and credited to the municipal account of each county.
